description: As a dispatcher I want to search and filter the aircraft list so that I can quickly locate specific aircraft.

acs.text: The search field accepts text input and filters results in real time.
The filter panel allows filtering by aircraft type, status, and base location.
When no results match the filter criteria, an empty state message is displayed.
branches: filters applied → no results → empty state message shown

acs.text: Clearing all filters restores the full aircraft list.

sections.content: The search operates on the aircraft registration number and aircraft name fields only.
Requires the aircraft reference catalog to be populated (see TEST-TCG-002).
